original_question: Marie tụrụ ahịa otu nri ọkụkọ nke ọnụ ahia ya bụ $12, mkpọ mmiri ara ise nke ọnụ ahia ya bụ $3 otunaotu, apụl anọ nke ọnụ ahia ya bụ $1.50 otunaotu, na ụfọdụ igbe piza. Marie kwụrụ na ngụkọta $50. Igbe piza ole ka Marie tụrụ ahịa ya maọbụrụ na ọnụ ahia igbe ọbụla bụ $8.50?
